about: When a Sales Order stops being editable from either app. Decided 17 September 2026. Both test suites read this file.
the_rule: Approval ends editing, for everyone. An approved order is pushed to SAP and lives there from then on; changes go through the manufacturing team, who reduce or drop a line that has not been made and ship what has. The rest of the order stays open and stays with the rep who raised it.
why: This is the honest position rather than a new restriction. Sync-SapOrders.ps1 has only ever CREATED a SAP order - there is no code path in the repository or the sync that updates one - so an edit saved after approval changed the ERPNext document, showed the rep a new quantity, and left the factory building the old one. Refusing the edit is strictly better than pretending it landed.
no_seniority_exemption: The GM exemption that applies to the 1 pm cutoff does NOT apply here. It exists because escalations arrive at the GM and an escalation with no power to act is a rubber stamp - but that is about approving, not about editing an order the factory is working to. No seniority makes an app edit reach SAP.
checked_as_stored: Every gate is re-checked against the order as STORED at the moment of the write, never against what the screen loaded. A manager can approve while a rep sits on the edit screen. There is no Server Script on this site to catch it afterwards.

can_edit.why: the ordinary case: raised, not yet approved, in the edit window, owned by this rep
approved is the end of it, whatever else is true
approved and already in SAP - the case the rule exists for
a rejected order is editable again - the rep is meant to fix what was wrong with it
can_edit.note: false only because the fixture's default owner is not the acting rep; ownership is asserted separately. The po_status itself does not block it.

can_edit.why: an order with no status at all has never been approved, so it is open

lock_reason.why: an approved order names the SAP number, because that is what the manufacturing team asks for on the phone
approved but not yet pushed - no number to quote yet, so none is invented
an unapproved order in the window is not locked at all

can_delete.why: approval means production has it - deleting is refused from here on, and was before this rule
a submitted document is never deleted from a phone
